title: Delivery Day Clustering and Missed Home Windows
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:order
| search delivery_day=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as deliveries sum(missed_home_flag) as missed_home_count by _time delivery_day
| sort - _time
description: Tracks delivery clustering and missed-home windows over time and breaks it out by delivery day.
value: Clustered deliveries may be efficient on paper but annoying if they repeatedly miss when someone is home.
implementation: Send delivery clustering and missed-home windows events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of delivery clustering and missed-home windows by delivery day.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how delivery clustering and missed-home windows changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
